top.name: PM Kisan Samman Nidhi
top.department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
top.eligibility_reason: Landholding cultivable land up to 2.0+ hectares and not an institutional landholder.

top.name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana
top.department: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
top.eligibility_reason: Notified crop grower cultivating in notified area with insurable interest.

top.name: Kisan Credit Card Scheme
top.eligibility_reason: Owner cultivator with valid land records eligible for institutional short-term credit.

top.name: PM Krishi Sinchayee Yojana (Per Drop More Crop)
top.department: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
top.eligibility_reason: Small and marginal farmer criteria met; micro-irrigation soil suitability pending verification.

top.name: Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana - Gramin
top.eligibility_reason: Requires SECC 2011 deprivation verification and Gram Sabha priority listing.

more.name: Soil Health Card Scheme
more.department: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
more.eligibility_reason: Open to all farmers holding cultivable agricultural land across states.

more.name: Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization (SMAM)
more.department: Department of Agriculture, Cooperation and Farmers Welfare
more.eligibility_reason: Small/marginal farmer subsidy tier available for tractor and equipment hiring.

more.name: PM KUSUM (Solar Agricultural Pumps)
more.department: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
more.eligibility_reason: Requires verification of grid power connectivity and local DISCOM cluster status.

more.name: Sub-Mission on Agri-Drones for Women SHGs
more.department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
more.eligibility_reason: Applicant is male; scheme is reserved exclusively for registered women Self Help Groups.
